widgets_values: This is a photograph featuring a close-up view of a textured white ceramic vase brimming with a bouquet of white and light blue flowers. The vase, which sits on a round wooden table, is intricately decorated with numerous small circular holes. The flowers in the bouquet include delicate white blossoms, with hints of green leaves and a few small blue flowers interspersed. The background is a light teal wall with paneled wainscoting. The lower portion of the wall is painted white, and the upper portion is teal. The lighting is soft and natural, highlighting the texture of the vase and the fine details of the flowers. The photograph is well-composed, with a focus on the vase and flowers, while the rest of the background is slightly out of focus, drawing attention to the main subject. The overall composition is elegant and minimalistic, with a serene and calming effect.<|end_of_text|>

这是一张特写照片，展现了一只布满纹理的白色陶瓷花瓶，瓶中插满了白色与浅蓝色的花束。花瓶置于圆形木桌上，瓶身装饰着无数精巧的小圆孔。花束中包含娇嫩的白色花朵，点缀着些许绿叶和几朵小巧的蓝色花朵。背景是一面浅青绿色的墙面，带有护墙板装饰——下半部刷成白色，上半部为青绿色。光线柔和自然，突显出花瓶的质感与花朵的细腻纹理。照片构图精妙，焦点集中在花瓶与花束上，背景其余部分略微虚化，从而引导视线聚焦主体。整体风格优雅简约，营造出宁静平和的氛围。
